name: Workload identity federation
short_description: Workload identity federation lets workloads outside Azure, such as GitHub Actions pipelines, exchange a trusted external token for a short-lived Microsoft Entra access token without storing secrets.

evidence.quote: Workload identity federation lets external services exchange their own identity tokens
Federated credentials solve the CICD problem.
When identity is handled via managed identities and workload identity federation
you can use federated identity credentials, basically specifying on your credentials which system can communicate
